name: Zenrin Co., Ltd.
summary: Zenrin Co., Ltd. engages in the collection and management of a range of geospatial information worldwide. It manufactures and sells maps, including residential maps, map databases, and other content; and map database maintenance services, as well as provides map services, map software, in-car navigation software, and related IT services. The company also manufactures and sells printed materials; development and sales of web systems; research and development of software; development of map database; development and sales of package system; provides marketing and business solutions; and location-based services.
